-The flowers that weren't interactable are now fixed
-The Language Flags have been adjusted to display properly on all resolutions
-A lot of small fixes and tweaks.

notes.title: Patch Fix for Windows versions: Crash Fixes and Graphical Fixes.
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We just wanted to let you know that we found the cause for the crashes happening in VR mode on Windows and the cause for the graphical glitches that popped up in the latest version of the game, it was due to using Unity's Experimental DirectX 12 mode. We have rectified this now and it should all work correctly again.

Sorry for the inconvenience everyone and thanks again for all the feedback and support.

notes.title: UPDATE (v1.3.2): A lot of small fixes and tweaks.
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We have just released the latest patch for 'n Verlore Verstand, v1.3.2, which brings in a lot of small fixes and tweaks and should sort out all the remaining issues that some players had with the input and random crashes. Below is a more detailed breakdown of the update.

Please let us know if you are still experiencing any issues and we will try to fix them as soon as we can. Thanks again for all the feedback everyone, we really appreciate it :)

Fixes:

-Input bug should be fixed now.
-The occasional startup crash introduced in v1.3 should now be fixed
-A lot of small fixes and tweaks.

Known Issues: When setting controls in VR use a controller, as mouse input and head look interaction doesnt work with the controller options screen.

Also be sure to check out the discussions for other Known Issues and fixes/workarounds that are detailed there.

We also have a new game on Steam Greenlight and we would really appreciate any support you can spare. Please be sure to give us a vote and let us know what you think:

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=755541257

There is also a Demo now available for 'n Verlore Verstand so if you want to try before you buy, be sure to check out the Demo.

P.S. Translated versions of this Update Note will be coming soon.

notes.title: UPDATE (v1.3.1): Some more fixes.
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Just wanted to let you all know that the latest update for 'n Verlore Verstand is now available and includes some new fixes, including a hopefully final fix for the input issue, no more camera jitter on moving platforms and more.

See the list below for the full details for v1.3.1

Fixes:

-Input bug should be fixed now.
-The occasional startup crash introduced in v1.3 has now been fixed
-Camera Kneeling has now been softened and made more comfortable.
-Moving Platforms dont cause camera jitter anymore
-Head Movement input with menus has been improved and an option to choose head movement or controller input for menus has been added
-Other small fixes.

Known Issues: VR Camera Target-Input for the menu system has picked up a bit of a bug and gets stuck sometimes, perhaps use a controller for now when playing in VR.

Also be sure to check out the discussions  for other Known Issues and fixes/workarounds are detailed there.

Thanks again for all the support and feedback everyone, we really appreciate it and we hope you enjoy the new update.

P.S. Translated versions of this Update Notes section of the store page will be coming soon.

notes.title: UPDATE (1.2): Some new VR features and fixes.
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Version 1.2 is here, sorry for the wait, and it adds some new VR features and fixes including the ability to now use your head movement as mouse movement and fixes for the camera height issues in the HTC Vive version of the game.

You can few the full list of Fixes/Additions and Known Issues down below.

Thanks again for all the support, feedback and patience everyone seriously you're all amazing. Stay tuned as we still have some additional 'm Verlore Verstand goodies in store for you all in the next few updates as well as any needed fixes that pop up.

Fixes/Additions in v1.2:

-Use Head Movement as camera movement feature added to allow for as much choice and comfort and to accommodate as many VR players and playing styles as possible. 
-VR Flash Overlay feature added to help alleviate any VR Sickness symptoms that some players might experience. 
-VR Nose Model feature added to help alleviate any VR Sickness symptoms that some players might experience.
-Camera height Issues are now fixed on HTC Vive.
-Some smaller fixes and balances.  

HTC Vive Users: If you are by chance still experiencing some high camera heights, try to Calibrate your headset to the Floor Height, with 0cm/inches between the Floor and Table Heights.

Also, Windows players please note that due to SteamVR integration, the Graphics and Resolution dialog doesn't pop-up automatically anymore but you can hold in the SHIFT button while pressing play in Steam (or running the .exe direct) to make the Graphics and Resolution Dialog appear before the game runs.

Oculus players on Windows, please note you need to run the normal Launch Option and not the SteamVR Launch Option.

There are still some minor issues that we need to sort out (with VR and Non-VR modes), but rest assured we will get them all sorted out as quick as we can. 

Please take a look at the Known Issues below and let us know if you run into any other problems.

Thanks again for all the amazing support and feedback everyone :)

Known Issues:

VR:

-The latest Oculus SDK/Runtime still needs to be implemented so that full Oculus integration is set up and the game works with the Oculus Home structure as well.

-The SteamVR Level Loading bar still needs to be implemented to prevent the player from waiting in the "White Room" while the next level loads.

Non-VR:

-Some Winodws 8.1 users may still not be able to play in Full screen, in this case add the -screen-fullscreen argument to your game's properties (Check the Discussions for details) or use Alt+Enter.

-Some Windows users seems to be having a problem interacting with the Game Menu when starting the game, this seems to be due to different conflicts as it seems to differ between the small amount of players that have experienced this issue. It is a tough issue to solve as it only seems to affect a very small amount of players and each case seems to be a bit different, but we will be sure to get it sorted as quick as we can.

-Some Linux users may experience some graphical glitches, in this case try running the game with the -force-opengl flag.

-Some minor tweaks, balances and bug fixes.

- VR Flash Overlay feature added to help alleviate any VR Sickness symptoms that some players might experience.
- VR Nose Model feature added to help alleviate any VR Sickness symptoms that some players might experience.

notes.title: UPDATE (0.9): SteamVR support now integrated. Final Release date announced.
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We just wanted to let you all know that the latest update for 'n Verlore Verstand is now available witch now brings HTC Vive/SteamVR support to the game on Windows (SteamVR doesn't support Mac and Linux yet via the Unity game engine).

Also, Windows players please note that due to SteamVR integration, the Graphics and Resolution dialog doesn't pop-up automatically anymore but you can hold in the SHIFT button while pressing play in Steam (or running the .exe direct) to make the Graphics and Resolution Dialog appear before the game runs.

Oculus players on Windows, please note you need to run the normal Launch Option and not the SteamVR Launch Option.

The next update will include the final batch of levels and sort out some necessary tweaks and bug fixes.

There are still some minor issues that we need to sort out (with VR and Non-VR modes), but rest assured we will have everything sorted out before the full release date on April 5th.

Please take a look at the Known Issues below and let us know if you run into any other problems.

Thanks again for all the amazing support and feedback everyone :)

Known Issues:

VR:

-The latest Oculus SDK/Runtime still needs to be implemented so that full Oculus integration is set up and the game works with the Oculus Home structure as well.

-The camera height in some levels are a bit too high on the HTC Vive and needs to be adjusted.

-The SteamVR Level Loading bar still needs to be implemented to prevent the player from waiting in the "White Room" while the next level loads.

-Full 360 degree audio needs to be implemented.

-Some levels experience some stuttering due to some frame drops, rest assured this will be sorted out before Final Release.

Non-VR:

-Wont play in Fullscreen on Windows 8.1 automatically and needs to be forced.

-Some Linux users are experiencing a crash when trying to play the game, which seems to be connected to the Controller plugin that we use. This will be sorted out before final release.

-Some players still experience a Mouse Flicker on certain levels, usually when clicking the Left Mouse Button.

-Some levels experience some framedrops, don't worry we will have this sorted  out before Final Release.

-Some minor tweaks, balances and bug fixes.

notes.title: UPDATE (0.9): SteamVR support now integrated. Final Release date announced.
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We just wanted to let you all know that the latest update for 'n Verlore Verstand is now available witch now brings HTC Vive/SteamVR support to the game on Windows (SteamVR doesn't support Mac and Linux yet via the Unity game engine).

Also, Windows players please note that due to SteamVR integration, the Graphics and Resolution dialog doesn't pop-up automatically anymore but you can hold in the SHIFT button while pressing play in Steam (or running the .exe direct) to make the Graphics and Resolution Dialog appear before the game runs.

Oculus players on Windows, please note you need to run the normal Launch Option and not the SteamVR Launch Option.

The next update will include the final batch of levels and sort out some necessary tweaks and bug fixes.

There are still some minor issues that we need to sort out (with VR and Non-VR modes), but rest assured we will have everything sorted out before the full release date on April 5th.

Please take a look at the Known Issues below and let us know if you run into any other problems.

Thanks again for all the amazing support and feedback everyone :)

Known Issues:

VR:

-The latest Oculus SDK/Runtime still needs to be implemented so that full Oculus integration is set up and the game works with the Oculus Home structure as well.

-The camera height in some levels are a bit too high on the HTC Vive and needs to be adjusted.

-The SteamVR Level Loading bar still needs to be implemented to prevent the player from waiting in the "White Room" while the next level loads.

-Full 360 degree audio needs to be implemented.

-Some levels experience some stuttering due to some frame drops, rest assured this will be sorted out before Final Release.

Non-VR:

-Wont play in Fullscreen on Windows 8.1 automatically and needs to be forced.

-Some Linux users are experiencing a crash when trying to play the game, which seems to be connected to the Controller plugin that we use. This will be sorted out before final release.

-Some players still experience a Mouse Flicker on certain levels, usually when clicking the Left Mouse Button.

-Some levels experience some framedrops, don't worry we will have this sorted  out before Final Release.

-Some minor tweaks, balances and bug fixes.

notes.title: UPDATE (v0.8.1): Big VR updates, Checkpoints and some fixes.
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The latest update for 'n Verlroe Verstand is now online which includes some big fixes for VR, Checkpoints and a few other fixes, please find the inlcuded fixes/additions detailed down below as well as Known Issues that we are still working on:

-VR now displays the correct Field of View and doesnt have the awkward Stretching effect anymore.
-Additional testing done on Mac and Linux to confirm said versions run without crashing. 
-Checkpoints have been added to all levels.
-Footsteps have been fixed to play from both left and right speakers now.
-Mouse/Gamepad Look Sensitivity settings have been added to the Control Menu.
-Mouse Cursor should stop flickering now (please let us know if it still does).

Thanks again for your patience everyone, as well as all the feedback and support. 

We will be sure to get the last few severe VR fixes in as fast as we can and then finish up the next level so that you can get the next experience planned for 'n Verlore Verstand.
